note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: three dated customs/B-L records (11.03.2025, 12.03.2025, 20.12.2025) with BOL numbers 8894288, 8937493, 8073811, all from Delhi TKD ICD / Tuglakabad ICD to the UAE (one record's destination field reads 'Jebel Ali, NEW ZEALAND', an obvious data artefact in the source). All three shipments go to a single counterparty group, Ajmal Steel Tubes & Pipes (Abu Dhabi, UAE) — one buyer, so the export base is narrow. Declared HS 740821 (copper-zinc brass wire) is close to but not identical with the actual recorded codes 74081990 and 74082990 (other copper alloy wire); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the factual code should be corrected to 74081990/74082990, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claimed as 'IT и электроника' is wrong: the goods are brass EDM wire, i.e. copper-alloy wire / metal products, not electronics. Revenue and export volume figures are not public — left null, not estimated. Domestic supply status unknown, not 'none found': the search backend was down and registry pages blocked, so nothing could be checked either way.
